title: Condition Gaussian components on charge without assuming Gaussian projected states
status_authority: Actual supplied derivations are available. No separate completed independent review of these new stages was delivered; prior accepted trajectory-cone results retain their own scope.

scientific_scope_status: A full-rank number-dephased mixture of five Gaussian states has a non-convex-Gaussian two-particle sector. A direct Pfaffian counting receiver nevertheless samples terminal occupations within a supplied charge-projected Gaussian component. A separate dual-rail bipartite interaction has the stated sharp positive-Gaussian trajectory threshold gamma_c=2||J||op.

unavailable_or_unclassified: The conditional component receiver does not acquire the outer reweighted mixture p_q(a) proportional to p(a)w_q(a). Fixed-charge projection, existence of a positive mixture and an efficient acquired mixture sampler are distinct. The threshold is sector/model-specific and is not a lower bound against every classical simulation. No broad new Gibbs-sampling or hardware advantage was acquired.
